no_server_freshness_signal: Checked, not assumed: no endpoint exposes uptime, start time or build id, so nothing on the wire can date this capture. captured_at is the recorder's clock and nothing corroborates it.
repo_head_is_not_the_server_identity: No onnx-genai-server binary carries its commit: no vergen, no env!("GIT_*"), no stamping build.rs, no version endpoint. This SHA is the tree the RECORDER ran from. It does not tell you which binary answered.
conditions: Idle-to-light load on a developer machine shared by concurrent agents. Fields that only appear under sustained load may legitimately be absent here; that is what DECLARED_ABSENT exists for.
